question: In August 2023, Former Indian cricketer ____ will become a "national icon" of the Election Commission (EC) to spread awareness regarding the need for greater voter participation in the electoral process.
solution:
The correct answer is __Sachin Tendulkar__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

 
• Sachin Tendulkar has been chosen as the national icon by the Election Commission of India to raise awareness about voting and educate voters for the upcoming 2024 elections.
